Terrible place ,youth hostel atmosphere with communal eating , bad food and high prices !!
Apr 2026 • Couples
The atmosphere is like a youth hostel ! There are no table for two, which is fine, exept that they added a couple at our table and then tried to add another client ! At that time I got up and said to the server NO ! Talking about service, it is almost non-existant, you have to go yourself to the cash counter because lack of service. When the food arrived it was terrible… a bowl full of chick peas in a very blend curry sauce with no vegetables only a small potato cut in 4 ! My wife had a tempeh with ginger and peanut sauce … absolutely terrible. We did not finish our meal, we just asked for the bill witch was the same price as the wonderful Indian restaurant right across the street , where you can eat delicious tasty vegetarian food, with excellent service at a better price! Oh, also the noise level was unbearable! So don’t go there unless you’re looking for a communal eating atmosphere with high prices and terrible service !
